title: Andy Reid: Mansoor Delane is doing well in recovery from shoulder injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Andy Reid: Mansoor Delane is doing well in recovery from shoulder injury
sources.description: The Chiefs traded first-, third- and fifth-round picks to move up and draft cornerback Mansoor Delane sixth overall, so when he was knocked out of Organized Team Activities with a shoulder injury, it was a concern.
